title: WISDOM project - V. Resolving molecular gas in Keplerian rotation around the supermassive black hole in NGC 0383
question: What is the mass of the supermassive black hole in NGC 0383, measured by forward-modelling resolved 12CO(2-1) gas kinematics?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 35 uJy/beam; cube rms 0.4 mJy/beam per 10 km/s channel

what.value: IRAM 30-m CO(2-1) flux 74.4±2.8 Jy km/s and CO(1-0) 29.8 Jy km/s

evidence.quote: Their CO(2–1) flux is $74.4\pm2.8$ Jy km s$^{-1}$.
at a distance of $66.6\pm9.9$ Mpc (cite: Freedman2001)

recipe.goal: Calibrate, combine and image CO cube
recipe.method: Standard pipeline calibration; combine two configs in CASA; uvcontsub; clean with Briggs 0.5 to 10 km/s channels
Masked moments with smoothed-cube mask at 0.8 x RMS; PVD from 5-pixel pseudo-slit at PA 142 deg
MGE fit to HST F160W + 2MASS H image; circular velocity from MGE_CIRCULAR_VELOCITY with M/L=1, scaled and SMBH point mass added
assumptions: Stellar mass dominates potential in inner parts; dark matter negligible

recipe.goal: Forward-model cube and fit SMBH mass
recipe.method: KinMS with gas particles from SkySampler of CLEAN components; MCMC fit to whole cube, 100,000 iterations; linear M/L profile; thin disc
key_parameters: Flat priors, SMBH mass flat in log-space; errors = RMS of line-free channels

recipe.method: Point-source continuum flux plus NED data fitted with power law

evidence.quote: the latter also yielding an exact $R_{\rm SOI}=316\pm60$ pc
The total CO(2–1) flux is 87.1 Jy km s$^{-1}$.
total integrated intensity of 65.2$\pm$0.1 mJy at a central frequency of 235.33 GHz
defines a systemic velocity of $V=4925\pm4$  km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: MCMC prior limits beyond table, convergence/burn-in details
X_CO and gas mass conversion used for gas disc
Beam/pixel treatment for KinMS gas particle number
Whether archive pipeline products were reused as is, and CASA version
score_reason: Data programmes and code public and method well described, but interactive clean masks and some settings are unspecified.
rediscovery_reason: Archival data with named codes, public KinMS code, and numeric results; some imaging details missing.
